# MyMobPay — UPI Payment Gateway for SaaS Founders

> Direct-to-bank UPI payment gateway with 0% transaction fees. Accept instant UPI payments with real-time automated verification, signed HMAC webhooks, and direct bank settlement. Built for SaaS founders, indie hackers, and developers who want full control over their payment infrastructure.

## Product Summary

MyMobPay eliminates the 2% + GST aggregator cut by routing UPI payments directly to your bank account via IMPS/UPI rails. Built for SaaS founders, indie hackers, and developers who want full control over their payment infrastructure.

### Core Features
- **0% Gateway Fees** — Flat ₹499/month subscription, no per-transaction charges
- **Direct Bank Settlement** — T+0 instant credit via IMPS/UPI, no escrow hold
- **Auto-Verification** — Bank email notifications parsed via Cloudflare Workers for real-time payment confirmation
- **HMAC-SHA256 Webhooks** — Cryptographically signed event notifications with automated retries
- **Developer-First** — Typed SDKs for Next.js, Node.js, Python, PHP, Flutter, React Native
- **Sandbox Environment** — Free isolated testing with live checkout simulation

### Supported UPI Applications
All standard UPI apps: Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, Amazon Pay, WhatsApp Pay, and any UPI-compatible application via QR code or direct payment intent.

## API Endpoints

- `POST /api/orders` — Create payment order with dynamic QR
- `GET /api/orders/:orderId` — Check order status
- `POST /api/webhooks/settlement` — Receive HMAC-signed payment events
- `GET /api/merchant/dashboard` — Real-time analytics (authenticated)
- `POST /api/auth/email-link/send` — Magic link authentication
